title: Industrial robot selection: seven robots, five criteria

source.citation: Keshavarz Ghorabaee, M., Zavadskas, E. K., Turskis, Z., Antucheviciene, J. (2016). A new combinative distance-based assessment (CODAS) method for multi-criteria decision-making. Economic Computation and Economic Cybernetics Studies and Research, 50(3), 25-44.
source.note: The journal issued no DOI for this volume; the RePEc handle RePEc:cys:ecocyb:v:50:y:2016:i:3:p:25-44 is the stable identifier. Read from the institutional repository copy of the published paper.

ranking.printedIn: Section 3.1, final ranking A2 > A3 > A1 > A7 > A4 > A6 > A5

notes: Criteria: LC load capacity (kg), RE repeatability (mm, cost), MTS maximum tip speed (mm/s), MC memory capacity (points), MR manipulator reach (mm). The example is the robot-selection data set used throughout the MCDM literature.
Every printed value of Tables 2 and 3 is reproduced, including E_i and T_i.

Table 4 (relative assessment matrix and H_i) is deliberately not part of this fixture. The copy that could be read is not antisymmetric (h_47 = h_74 = -0.0746) and several entries match neither E_i - E_k nor Eq. (9); whether this is a printing error or an extraction error could not be settled without the typeset page. Recomputed with Eq. (9) and tau = 0.02, H = 0.5122, 1.4633, 1.0715, -0.2125, -1.8515, -1.1717, 0.1887, which gives exactly the printed ranking. P2.4 should confirm Table 4 against the PDF before adding it.
